summary: Independently verified SDLC Governance Platform iteration 5 scope. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (test_auth_admin_ledger.py) covering 8-user seed, admin-gating on /api/admin/users and /api/ledger/rebuild, token issue/me/revoke lifecycle, triage 401/403-wrong-role/403-segregation/200-success paths, assignments PUT, evidence-pack PDF+DOCX downloads, ledger /verify valid=true before and after new triage writes. Frontend: user-switcher + role-switcher work (native <select>; only user-assigned roles exposed per user), Admin nav visible only for u-ramesh, Admin page lists 8 users, role-toggle produces 'Role assignment updated' toast, issue-token-btn opens issued-token-dialog with one-time token value, revoke buttons present and clickable. Findings Explorer: triage while signed-out shows 'Sign in' error toast; triage as Priya on an eligible finding produces 'Triage decision recorded' success toast. Traceability and L2 Adjudication pages render without errors. Ledger integrity bug from iteration_4 is now fixed (valid=true, 1539+ chained entries).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx shows role-toggle and issue-token-btn only after a user card (data-testid=admin-user-<id>) is selected. This is correct UX but a bit non-obvious for automated tests — the data-testids are well-named so no action required.

role_toggle data-testid uses the raw role display name (e.g. 'role-toggle-<projectId>-Programme Manager'), which contains spaces & special chars. Current tests use prefix matching (data-testid^="role-toggle-") which works, but downstream testers should know to quote the full value if needed.
/api/admin/users returns a composite object {users, projects, roles} rather than a bare array — fine but worth documenting.
test_credentials: Admin: gov-demo-u-ramesh-token-2026 (u-ramesh / mishraramesh@gmail.com). Non-admin test tokens for u-neha, u-priya, u-rohit used. UI sign-in via header user-switcher (no password).
seed_data_creation: Test issued one API token for u-neha (immediately revoked). Priya triaged a handful of CTRL-08 findings with reason 'TEST_pytest segregation probe' (dismiss). Ledger remained valid=true after these writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth/admin/ledger/evidence-pack scope is fully green. Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_admin_ledger.py. Ledger valid=true (1539+ entries). Admin page requires clicking data-testid=admin-user-<id> before role-toggle/issue-token-btn render. Role display names like 'Security & Privacy Lead' / 'IV&V Lead' / 'Programme Manager' are what the backend accepts in TriageDecisionRequest.role. L2 Adjudication currently has 0 pending items on seeded projects — decide buttons could not be exercised but page renders cleanly.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. Prior-iteration ledger valid=false (iteration_4) is now resolved: current GET /api/ledger/verify returns valid=true and stays valid after fresh writes, confirming the asyncio.Lock serialization fix in ledger.append_to_ledger is working.
